name: com.nekosune.world-ui-assistant
description: Build VRChat world UI without knowing Unity UI: a New panel wizard with themes, one-click widgets (title, text, button, toggle, slider, image, divider, spacer, row, grid, scroll list), a drag-to-reorder outline and plain-English editing that explains the Unity components behind each part. Open via NekoSune → World → UI Assistant.
